requires.why: GPIO0 of the board's ESP32 WiFi module: held low, it makes the ESP32 reset the board.

source.ref: github.com/ulx3s/ulx3s-examples blinky/blinky.v (c953d25): "Tie GPIO0, keep board from rebooting"
